item.title: HRSA discloses manufacturers approved for revised 340B rebate pilot
item.description: Ten drugmakers will see 21 of their drugs move from upfront discounts to after-the-fact payments in the drug discount program at the start of next year, an expansion from the Trump administration’s first attempt at kickstarting a rebate pilot.
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Pifer Parduhn

item.title: Data privacy concerns could hold patients back from using AI
item.description: Although artificial intelligence has quickly become integrated into our daily lives, Americans say they’re becoming increasingly concerned about their health data, making them less likely to use it for tasks like finding providers, according to a new survey.
item.dc:creator: Anuja Vaidya

item.title: Insurers say their 2027 Medicare Advantage offerings preserve benefits. The data tells a different story
item.description: A Leerink Partners analysis of Medicare Plan Finder shows how the largest MA carriers are cutting dental allowances and premium givebacks next year as they continue to prioritize margin recovery.
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Pifer Parduhn
